author: tersec
content: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5472 seems a bit nicer. simpler while still bounding DoSes by a constant factor vs https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5491 and crucially decoupling fork choice from builder bid processing

author: pawandhananjay
content: i prefer nico's PR. It fits better with LH's implementation and its a bit easier to reason about constant number of things to handle

author: tersec
content: anything fork choice-related has a delicacy in that it's ... not actually that fast (in a hot part of the slot; i.e. it's measurable lag) and while it's possible to just be really careful to time things correctly, that kind of temporal reasoning is quite a bit trickier than 5472 requires to be confident regarding correctness and testability

author: potuz
content: I also prefer Nico's PR after thinking about processing attestations every slot will be a nightmare. I can't think of any simple way of dealing with the PB reorgs other than just ignoring them so I think it's just simpler to go with Nico's PR and hope there's no DOS in this topic
